data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter switch button with minimal design and material animation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom switch button widget that supports minimal design and material animations. It can be used as a standard switch or toggle button with customizable colors and size.
use_when: You need a minimally designed switch button with material animations.
You want to customize the on and off colors of a toggle control.
avoid_when: You need complex form integration with built-in validation states out of the box.
strengths: Highly customizable with size, onColor, and offColor properties.
